items.info: Aft pedestal, parking brake handle. Pull up to set. Once EICAS has power, a cyan PARK BRAKE ON message confirms it.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Main panel. Check the EMERG LT switch is armed.
items.label: Emergency Lights

items.info: Main panel. Standby power. To test it first: hold TEST and check the green light, then ON and check the amber light.
items.label: Stby Power

items.info: Main panel. Batt 1 and Batt 2.
items.label: Batteries

items.info: Main panel. Enable the Ground Power Unit on the FFX EFB Ground Services page first. Switch off once the APU is running.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Main panel.
items.label: Nav Lights

items.info: Main panel. Avionics and EICAS switches.
items.label: Avionics + EICAS

items.info: IRS controls. Set both to ALIGN, then NAV. Align time can be set in the FFX EFB.
items.label: IRS

items.info: APU control panel, forward of the right circuit breaker panel. Check LH Fuel Boost NORM. Starter Disengage NORMAL, APU Master ON, push APU Test and check the APU warning lights, APU Generator ON, APU Bleed OFF, check at least 22 V DC. Hold the Start switch up to START until the APU RELAY ENGAGED light comes on; this can take up to 5 seconds, and the switch springs back to NORM. RELAY ENGAGED goes out before READY TO LOAD comes on. Then Load Shed NORM, and check APU amps below 300 on the right meter panel.
items.label: APU

items.info: Required for engine start. A cross-bleed start is only for an inoperative APU.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Main panel.
items.label: Fuel Crossfeed

items.info: Pedestal. Flight control shut-off switches.
items.label: Flt Control Shut-Offs

items.info: Turn the rotary test selector to each position and check the annunciations and warnings, then OFF.
items.label: Warning Systems Test

items.info: Left wall. Test the oxygen mask. Check the oxygen pressure gauges on the main panel.
items.label: Oxygen Mask

items.info: Radios. Get ATIS and the ATC clearance.
items.label: ATIS / ATC

items.info: FMS. POS INIT is mandatory: NAV > IDENT, check database, wait for GPS 1 POS, LOAD. Then the flight plan (NAV > SIMBRIEF > FPLN RECALL, or enter it manually), departure, arrival, PERF INIT (trans alt, cruise alt, SYNC EFB, CONFIRM INIT) and TAKEOFF pages. Load weight and balance via the FFX EFB.
items.label: FMS Preflight

items.info: Weather radar off. Preselect the NAV source (FMS for a GPS flight plan).
items.label: PFD & MFD

items.info: Set local QNH.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: EICAS > FUEL HYD page. Check quantity and balance.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Doors and windows closed and locked.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Check messages, then select the SYS ENG page to monitor the start.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: ATC / TCAS. Set the squawk, leave TCAS in STBY.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: PFD. Set and confirm V-speeds from the FMS takeoff data. They appear on the PFD once the flaps are set for takeoff.
items.label: V-Speeds

items.info: Main panel. Closed is vertical.
items.label: PAC Isol Valve

items.info: Ground Rec/Anti-Coll lights switch. GND REC for start and taxi.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: PASS SAFETY for engine start. Set SEAT BELTS after start.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: Pedestal. Full aft. If they are not fully aft, set the hardware throttle to IDLE and click the lever with the mouse.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Right engine first. Check EICAS start pressure at least 30 PSI and residual ITT at most 200°C, then press the RH engine start button.
items.label: Start Button (R)

items.info: Pedestal. At 10% N2, click the right lever to IDLE. Ignition comes on at about 14% N2 and fuel at about 33% N2. The start ends by 57% N2, when the START and DISENGAGE lights go out.
items.label: Thrust Lever (R)

items.info: EICAS. Monitor N1, ITT, fuel flow and oil pressure.
items.label: Engine Instruments (R)

items.info: Same as the right engine. Check start pressure and residual ITT first.
items.label: Start Button (L)

items.info: Pedestal. At 10% N2, click the left lever to IDLE.
items.label: Thrust Lever (L)

items.info: EICAS. Monitor N1, ITT, fuel flow and oil pressure.
items.label: Engine Instruments (L)

items.info: EICAS > FUEL HYD page. Hyd A and B both about 3,000 PSI.
items.label: Hydraulic Pressure

items.info: DC power panel, left of the pedestal. LH and RH GEN switches to GEN. The GEN OFF L-R message clears.
items.label: Generators

items.info: MFD SYS ELEC page. Positive volts and amps on the RH and LH buses.
items.label: Electrical Buses

items.info: EICAS or MFD SYS ENG page, START PRESS. APU bleed OFF, PAC Isol valve closed, both engine bleeds LP/HP and check positive PSI. Then check each engine bleed OFF (zero PSI) and back to LP/HP, with the PAC Isol valve open for the left side. Finish with PAC Isol closed and APU bleed as desired.
items.label: Cross Bleed Check

items.info: Yoke and pedals. Free and full movement.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Main panel, anti-ice switches.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Main panel. Set the landing field elevation and leave the switches in NORM. NORM schedules the cabin automatically and uses the landing field elevation for the descent. ALT SEL needs the target cabin altitude set by hand. MANUAL means working the outflow valves by hand, for when the automatic mode fails.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: Pedestal.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pedestal, parking brake handle.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Check braking and steering once moving. Check engine and flight instruments.
items.label: Brakes / Steering

items.info: Deploy the reversers, set the reverser switch to STOW EMERG, verify UNLOCK and DEPLOY lights off. Stow the reversers and set the switch back to NORM.
items.label: Thrust Reversers

items.info: FGCP. Meant to stay on all the time.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: FGCP. Meant to stay on all the time.
items.label: Mach Trim

items.info: Main panel, ATS button. Push to arm it on the ground (amber light on the button). N1 TO then engages when you press TO/GA. ATS can be enabled or disabled in the FFX EFB options.
items.label: ATS

items.info: FGCP. Best to arm only NAV for takeoff, no vertical modes. Set altitude with the knob on the pedestal or the screws on the main panel. Press the TOGA button on the thrust levers for TO mode and check FMA TO|TO.
items.label: FGCP Modes

items.info: Pitot and static heaters, LH and RH.
items.label: Pitot Heat

items.info: Windshield heaters, LH and RH.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Pedestal, flap handle. Default 15°. Check flap and slat indication on EICAS.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Zero %, handle full forward.
items.label: Speed Brakes

items.info: Set for takeoff in the green range on EICAS. Use the stab trim table for your CG and flap setting. CG is on the MSFS 2024 aircraft load page.
items.label: Stab Trim

items.info: Pedestal.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Ground Rec/Anti-Coll lights switch. Set ANTI-COLL when entering the runway.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Pedestal. On when entering the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: No NO TAKEOFF warning.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Pedestal. Hold the brakes and advance to the TO/MC detent. The FADEC mode indicator shows a green T/O. TO/MC thrust is limited to 5 minutes.
items.label: Thrust Levers
Brakes
items.info: Toe brakes. Release once TO/MC is set. On a rolling takeoff they can be released before setting thrust, but the runway needed is longer.
Rotate to about 13° pitch. Maintain at least V2 and follow the FD.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Main panel, landing gear handle. At positive rate.
items.label: Gear

items.info: FGCP. LNAV for a GPS flight plan, VNAV + FLC for the climb.
items.label: FGCP Modes

items.info: FGCP. Engage at your own discretion.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Pedestal. Lower the nose toward 250 KIAS and retract above 170 KIAS.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. CLB detent once flaps are up. The FMS default limit is 250 kts below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Pedestal. The taxi lights already went out at liftoff, since weight-on-wheels switches keep them off in flight. This sets the switch off.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pedestal.
items.label: Engine Sync

items.info: APU control panel, forward of the right circuit breaker panel. Shut down before climbing above FL310: Start switch STOP, APU Bleed OFF, check READY TO LOAD off, APU Master OFF.
items.label: APU

items.info: Pedestal. Passing FL180.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Passenger advisory lights.
items.label: Passenger Signs

items.info: At transition altitude. 29.92 in / 1013 hPa.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Pedestal. CRU detent or as required.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: EICAS > FUEL HYD page. Quantity and balance. Crossfeed needs the X-Feed control set and the boost pump of the non-feeding tank off.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: At very high altitude a minimum engine power may be needed to hold cabin pressure.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: FMS PERF > DESCENT page shows the time to TOD.
items.label: Top of Descent

items.info: EICAS.
items.label: Engine Instruments

items.info: FMS. Confirm runway and weather, set NAV > Approach and PERF > Landing. VREF and VAPP can also be set with the MFD softkeys.
items.label: Landing Data

items.info: FGCP. For a VNAV descent, preselect the target altitude (ideally the final fix) and arm no other vertical mode.
items.label: FGCP Altitude

items.info: Main panel. Check the landing field elevation is set for the destination. In ALT SEL, set the cabin altitude to the field elevation.
items.label: Pressurization

items.info: At TOD. In VNAV the AP should switch to VPATH at TOD. Manage speed with the thrust levers. The FMS default limit is 250 kts below 10,000 ft.
items.label: Descent

items.info: At transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Main panel, LH and RH.
items.label: Ignition

items.info: Main panel.
items.label: Fuel Crossfeed
Passenger Signs
items.info: Passenger advisory lights.
Pedestal. Passing FL180 on the descent.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Weight-on-wheels switches keep the taxi lights off in flight, so they come on at touchdown.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Pedestal.
items.label: Engine Sync
Pressurization
items.info: Main panel. The cabin should reach zero differential pressure at touchdown.
APU control panel, forward of the right circuit breaker panel. The APU can run in flight up to 31,000 ft.
items.label: APU

items.info: Pedestal. After the initial approach fix or near the airport, slow below 210 KIAS and select flaps 15. Keep at least VREF + 20 KIAS with flaps 15.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: FGCP, APP button. ILS: verify LOC and GS armed on the FMA. RNAV: verify GP armed. Intercept the localizer first, then the glideslope from below.
items.label: Approach Mode

items.info: Main panel, landing gear handle. Approaching the final approach fix, or one dot from glideslope intercept on an ILS. Max 210 KIAS. Check 3 green.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Below 180 KIAS, as the final descent begins. Then hold VREF to VREF + 10 KIAS.
items.label: Flaps
Speed Brakes
items.info: Pedestal. Zero %, handle full forward.
Off by 170 ft AGL on an ILS, 400 ft AGL on other approaches. Cross the threshold at VREF.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Pedestal. At 50 ft, slowly to IDLE, or check that ATS retards them.
items.label: Thrust Levers

items.info: Touch down on the main wheels.
items.label: Flare

items.info: Pedestal. At touchdown.
items.label: Speed Brakes
Brakes
items.info: Toe brakes. After the nosewheel is on the runway. Hold forward elevator pressure to keep it there.
Deploy after nosewheel contact. Idle reverse by 65 KIAS.
items.label: Thrust Reversers

items.info: Pedestal. After vacating the runway.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Ground Rec/Anti-Coll lights switch. Set ANTI-COLL when crossing a runway.
